I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Description of the land Boundaries for the plots of lands bearing the following names and the extents in the Advanced Tracing No. GA/BPP/2023/61 of 29.03.2023 made by the Surveyor General and situated in the Division of Grama Niladhari No. 121 of Wakwella in Wakwella Village in Poddala Bope Divisional Secretary’s Division of Galle District in the Southern Province.

1. Lot ‘A ’ – Karijjellawatta - Extent : about 0.0466 Hectare North: Road; East: Karijjellawatta Addara Kumbura Remaining portion of this land; South: Karijjellawatta Addara Kumbura Remaining portion of this land and road (Road Development Authority); West:Road (Road Development Authority). Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
